results.summary:
The reclaim chain now honors `manual` exactly like `remote`: `src/dispatch.js` takes the "liveness is the heartbeat" branch for `a.remote || a.manual`, so a hand-claimed attempt (`hkb claim <n>` with no --spawn, which has always written `manual: true` at src/cli.js:419) is never judged by the 180s no-handle rule that used to call it crashed three minutes into every tick — releasing the lock under a live worker and killing its next heartbeat with LOCK_LOST. It is still bounded by stale_after and max_runtime, so an attempt that stops beating is reclaimed as `reclaimed` after stale_after (1h default).

Two fake-gh tests in test/dispatch.test.js pin both halves; I verified both fail on the pre-fix code and pass after. Docs: skills/kanban/SKILL.md gains a "claim by hand" bullet in the board-management section (the heartbeat is the only thing holding the attempt), and references/protocol.md documents `manual: true` in the attempt schema and in step 2 of the tick. docs/wiki/architecture/overview.md was re-stamped (its prose was already correct) and log.md notes it; ADR-004 was deliberately left untouched — it is a decision record, and ticking off its own follow-up list would be task state, which docs/wiki/AGENTS.md keeps out of the wiki, so `wiki-check.mjs` still reports it stale.

Draft PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/68 (branch worktree-kb-65-1).
